# PocketNES sprite-follow hints keyed by CRC32 of the ROM payload (iNES header
# stripped), extracted from the PocketNES Menu Maker database (pnesmmw.mdb,
# Titney & Mr Unown, 2003; https://github.com/GamingFanboy365/pnesmmw).
# Format: <crc32> <mode> <hex value>
#   S nn   = follow NES OAM sprite number nn (PocketNES flags bit 4, legacy)
#   M aaaa = follow the NES RAM byte at $aaaa, a screen Y (flags bit 5, FOLLOWMEM)
# PocketNES itself only follows vertically: windowtop = Y*5/16 from that byte.
